terbaru.judul: Learning LDPC codes with density evolution over relaxed protographs
terbaru.pelajaran: We consider the design of low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes for a given iterative decoder.

terbaru.judul: Bayesian Optimization of Genetic Algorithm Hyperparameters in a Multi-Fidelity Framework for Efficient Lattice Material Design
terbaru.pelajaran: This study presents a multi-fidelity framework for the systematic optimization of genetic algorithm (GA) hyperparameters.

terbaru.judul: Evaluating Endpoint Detection Robustness Against Genetic Algorithm Driven Code Transformations
terbaru.pelajaran: In addition, we propose a reproducible benchmark for endpoint detection robustness evaluation, motivating the need for robustness-aware defensive monitoring and behavioral correlation.

terbaru.judul: Characterizing an inverse Compton X-ray source and determining its electron beam parameters using a genetic algorithm
terbaru.pelajaran: Inverse Compton X-ray sources are laboratory-scale devices providing quasi-monochromatic synchrotron radiation which is generated by laser photons Compton-scattering off highly relativistic electrons.

terbaru.judul: A Decomposition-Based Framework for Joint Optimization and Spatial Packaging of Interconnected Systems with Physical Interactions
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents an approach and application of optimization of spatial packaging of interconnected systems with physical interactions (SPI2) in three-dimensional component placement problems.

terbaru.judul: Reward-Density Heuristic for Dynamic Multi-Vehicle Routing: Performance and Computational Efficiency
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose and evaluate a reward-density heuristic for dynamic multi-vehicle assignment, referred to as the Efficiency heuristic.

terbaru.judul: EVTradeMatch: A Mobility-Aware Multi-Objective Matching Framework for EV--EV Energy Trading
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes EVTradeMatch, a prediction-guided multi-objective optimization framework for mobility-aware EV--EV energy trading.

terbaru.judul: Discrete-Time MDP Modeling for Multi-Item Capacitated Lot Sizing with Stochastic Demand Timing
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper studies a finite-horizon multi-item capacitated lot-sizing problem in which demand quantities are deterministic, while demand-arrival periods are stochastic.

terbaru.judul: ArcheoLab: A hands-on course to engage students in applied mathematics
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we describe ``Archeolab: Computed Tomography and Virtual Unwrapping of Scrolls'', an interdisciplinary undergraduate course guiding students through the virtual reading of scrolls.
